title: Bright Yellow Michelle
style: sweet jazz pop, female lead, soft piano, brushed drums, upright bass, light clarinet, warm dreamy, playful uplifting, 100 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle on the court today
Bright yellow ball, ready to play
Paddle in hand, sun on her face
Michelle smiling in her favorite place

[Chorus]
Bright yellow, bright yellow
Michelle and the little ball
Bright yellow, bright yellow
Michelle is having a ball

[Verse 2]
Soft little drop over the line
Michelle is right on time
Light feet, soft hands, sunny day
Michelle just loves to play

[Chorus]
Bright yellow, bright yellow
Michelle and the little ball
Bright yellow, bright yellow
Michelle is having a ball

[Bridge]
Like a bee to a flower
Michelle in her power
Gentle game, gentle heart
Michelle is a work of art

[Outro]
Bright yellow forever
Michelle and the ball, together
